highlights_headline: This unreleased head backports Apple 26.0 library support and fixes a WinUI projection DLL resolution bug.

bullets.detail: Backports the Apple 26.0 native library and unversioned app TFM support to the 3.119.x line.
Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support
